title: Seeded state, steppable pages and a probe per workflow
note: A seeded reset, probes that report what the project holds, named views and a demo per workflow — what makes a build measurable by the harness at all.
intent: The same seed must produce the same run, always: reset(seed) returns the project to a known state (empty the store, load fixtures from a seeded generator, go back to the first screen) and never reads Math.random, the wall clock or the network. The studio paces the page's own loop and freezes time while it judges, so a timer or animation that matters must be driven by requestAnimationFrame or a clock the page reads from Date.now, not by something the studio cannot see. installStudio({ probes }) returns what the project holds as numbers and short strings (items.length, selection, route, form.valid), one probe per thing a person could check; do not invent counters for features that do not exist. Declare views for the screens worth photographing (a route, a dialog, the empty and error states) and one demo per workflow the generic exercise cannot reach (add then delete, sign in, drag a card). Every control must produce a visible change within a frame or two; the page reports its own activity (clicks, typing, navigations, reactions, errors) in state().ui, so nothing needs faking.

check.note: After the harness exercises the page, it answered: state().ui.reactions or ui.edits rose. A page that reports no change before and after is one whose controls do nothing visible. needs names the paths delta() reads, so a build that reports nothing is unmeasured, not passed.

port: Only the owner of the entry (src/main.js, src/studio.js, index.html) installs window.__studio: reset, probes, views and demos are declared there, each facet adds one probe key per thing it ships and a demo that reaches its workflow; run check_project after any structural change.

evidence.note: The contract service reseeds, resets and pauses, and steps independently of wall clock. Expose actual project state; no stock content is required.
